templates.body:
[Text content only; the full HTML (~150 lines) is the Findoc branded layout with the FINDOST header and legal footer]

Welcome to the Findoc ${roleLabel} Network

Dear ${name},
Congratulations! Welcome to the Findoc ${roleLabel} Network.
${applicationLabel} has been successfully verified and approved. You are now officially a Findoc ${roleLabel}.

Your Partner Details
${codeLabel}: ${code}
Registered Mobile: ${mobileNumber}
Relationship Manager: ${rmName}
RM Contact: ${rmContact}

Next Steps
You will shortly receive a separate email with your Partner Console login credentials, referral link setup instructions, and partner resources.
For onboarding, payout and business support, please connect with your RM, ${rmName}.
For dashboard, product training and growth-related queries, you can contact the Training & Development Manager.

Warm regards,
Team Findoc
